# Token Reference Table

This table lists all tokens for this component:

| Token | Description |
|-------|------------|
| content.padding | Controls the internal spacing inside page content areas (the main content sections of web pages). This creates breathing room around the page content.<br>CSS variable: --wm-page-content-padding |
| content.background | Sets the background color of page content areas (the main content sections of web pages). This is the main background color that appears behind the page content.<br>CSS variable: --wm-page-content-background |
| content.border.color | Sets the color of the border around page content areas. This determines the color of the line that outlines the page content section.<br>CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-color |
| content.border.width | Controls the thickness of the border around page content areas. When set to 0, there is no visible border.<br>CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-width |
| content.border.style | Controls the style of the border around page content areas. 'none' removes the border, 'solid' creates a continuous line, 'dashed' creates a broken line, 'dotted' creates small dots.<br>CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-style |
| content.border.radius | Controls the corner rounding of page content areas. When set to 'none', the page content has sharp corners. Higher values create more rounded corners for a softer appearance.<br>CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-radius |
| content.shadow | Controls the drop shadow effect around page content areas. This creates a subtle shadow that makes the page content appear to float above the background, giving it depth and elevation.<br>CSS variable: --wm-page-content-shadow |
